clips.title: The story
paras: Newly awakened Forsaken leave Deathknell's crypts to face an unfamiliar life. Freed from the Lich King's grip, you are sent down the hill, away from the incinerators, to learn what comes next from Shadow Priest Sarvis.

In Deathknell's damp, subterranean crypt, the chill greets you as you open your eyes to undeath. Undertaker Mordo watches over the newly buried, sorting those who regain free will from those bound for the burning pits. Many rise to find rot, cold stone, and confusion. By chance, they have slipped the Scourge's grasp.

Before reaching the chapel, you must face a grim truth: you were once a mindless tool of the Lich King. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner broke that psychic enslavement, freeing remnants of your former humanity to reclaim independent thought. Leaving the tomb and heading down into Deathknell begins your life in a world where both the living and the Scourge see you as an abomination to be destroyed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.
I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.
Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...
I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... Situation... To you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
